標題： [Notice of Library Closure] The library will be closed on 5/10-11 (Saturday and Sunday).
日期： Thu, 1 May 2025 10:19:50 +0800

On 5/10-11 (Saturday and Sunday), the library will be closed due to the large-scale event "ReTide Project Music Festival" organized by the National Dong Hwa University Student Union. We apologize for the inconvenience caused. Students who need to study on their own can use the C109 classroom of the School of Management in addition to the Study Center.
